Class ItemBase

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.item.Item
org.moddingx.libx.base.ItemBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.world.flag.FeatureElement, net.minecraft.world.level.ItemLike, net.neoforged.neoforge.common.extensions.IItemExtension, CreativeTabItemProvider
Direct Known Subclasses:
ItemInventory
public class ItemBase extends net.minecraft.world.item.Item implements CreativeTabItemProvider
Base class for items for mods using ModXRegistration. This will automatically set the creative tab if it's defined in the mod.
